command.farmstead_fart_together.info.pla: Cooldown %s s, cloud radius %s, toots %s, your client %s
command.farmstead_fart_together.info.ser: Server: gas %s, cloud %s s, scares mobs %s, effects %s, beans and cabbage %s
command.farmstead_fart_together.reload: Fart Together server settings reloaded: %s problems, %s food entries
config.farmstead_fart_together.about.iss: Report a bug or an idea
config.farmstead_fart_together.about.unk: Update check: not done (switched off, or no answer from Modrinth)
config.farmstead_fart_together.general.c: Once at start-up, ask Modrinth whether a newer Fart Together is out and say so in the log. Sends nothing about you.
config.farmstead_fart_together.general.g: Show the gas meter above the hotbar while you have gas (on servers that run the mod).
config.farmstead_fart_together.general.p: Play the toot pose, yours and others'. Off: only the cloud and the sound.
config.farmstead_fart_together.general.s: Every sound becomes a soft puff: for streams and videos with strict platform rules.
config.farmstead_fart_together.mystyle.h: Your toot as friends see it
config.farmstead_fart_together.mystyle.p: Plays your toot here, for you only. Others see it after Done.
config.farmstead_fart_together.particles: How many cloud particles to draw. 0 hides the cloud for you only.
Draw the gas cloud a toot leaves behind for a few seconds (yours and other players').
Most particles one toot of another player may draw on your screen. Lower it on a weak PC.
config.farmstead_fart_together.picker.ad: Adds exactly what is typed, for a #tag or an id from a mod that is not loaded.
config.farmstead_fart_together.preset.to: Sets every value below at once. Values you change afterwards are kept.
config.farmstead_fart_together.preview.n: Join a world to see yourself
config.farmstead_fart_together.sounds.mu: Do not hear other players' toots (you still see the cloud).
config.farmstead_fart_together.sounds.vo: Loudness of every toot, yours and others'.
config.farmstead_fart_together.style.amo: How many particles your cloud has. The server may cap it.
config.farmstead_fart_together.style.col: #RRGGBB, a preset (swamp, bean, lilac, gold, pumpkin, pine, sky, rose), gradient:#A,#B, random or rainbow. Gradients and rainbow need the server's permission.
config.farmstead_fart_together.style.dur: How long your cloud keeps puffing out. The server may cap it.
config.farmstead_fart_together.style.oth: Theirs: each player's own style. Simple: everyone gets the plain green puff. Mine: everyone looks like you.
config.farmstead_fart_together.style.par: The shape of your cloud's particles.
config.farmstead_fart_together.style.pit: Pitch of your sound: below 1 lower, above 1 higher.
config.farmstead_fart_together.style.pos: Classic: lean forward, hands on knees, a glance back. Hero: chest out, hands on hips. None: no pose.
config.farmstead_fart_together.style.siz: How big your particles are. The server may cap it.
config.farmstead_fart_together.style.sou: random, or one of: short, squeaky, bubbly, long, trumpet, tiny, rumble, puff.
config.farmstead_fart_together.style.vol: How loud your toot is for everyone who hears it.
config.farmstead_fart_together.title: Fart Together settings
config.farmstead_fart_together.try.toolt: Closes this screen and makes a puff behind you with the current settings. Only you see it.
farmstead_fart_together.command.problems: Fart Together settings: %s problem(s), see below. Fix the file and run /farttogether reload again.
message.farmstead_fart_together.disabled: Toots are switched off for you on this server
message.farmstead_fart_together.no_gas: Not enough gas: eat something first (beans work best)
